VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent describes a plausible root cause and fix (pagination cursor handling), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to confirm that:
1. All 58 tests actually pass
2. The export truncation issue is genuinely resolved
3. The fix was correctly implemented

Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot independently validate objective, measurable acceptance criteria like "all 58 tests pass."
